<details class="nhsuk-details">
<summary class="nhsuk-details__summary"><span class="nhsuk-details__summary-text">Text description of this diagram</span></summary>
<div class="nhsuk-details__text">

Five phases drawn as a circuit, read clockwise, each in a filled box. Phases 1, 2 and 3 run left
to right across the top. An arrow comes down the right-hand side to Phase 4. An arrow runs back
along the bottom to Phase 5. A green arrow goes up the left-hand side from Phase 5 to Phase 1,
closing the loop, and is marked: lessons go into the next scoping. Phase 1 is engagement and scoping,
Phase 2 design, Phase 3 analysis, Phase 4 delivery, communication and sign-off, and Phase 5 review. Phase 5 is green
and the other four are blue.

A panel below, headed "running through all five phases", reads: quality assurance and customer and
stakeholder engagement.

</div>
</details>
